policy.starterKitContains: metadata, lock files and verification instructions only
policy.installerOwns: download, signature verification, SHA-256 pinning, offline media and installation

pythonStrategy.reason: The full Python wheelhouse needs a normal CPython layout, SSL and venv support. A per-user install avoids administrator elevation and USB drive-letter fragility; the installer can still carry the official EXE and wheelhouse offline.
pythonStrategy.usbPortableAlternative: not selected for the main path; the embeddable ZIP lacks the normal pip/venv workflow and is less suitable for the package set

artifacts.purpose: CPython runtime for local data, document, PDF, media and optional stateful Skills

detect.expected: Python 3.11 or newer; the locked offline build is 3.12.10

authenticode.policy: Valid Windows Authenticode chain and trusted Python Software Foundation publisher; record signer subject and timestamp in installer log.

sha256.source: Python release page and installer-side Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256

install.path: Do not edit system PATH; installer records absolute python.exe and can add a user PATH entry only after confirmation

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Use Windows installed-app uninstall for the same per-user version; upgrade only after verifying a new runtime and wheelhouse against a new lock record. Never delete an unrelated Python installation.

artifacts.purpose: Offline Python wheelhouse for the Skills that retain real Python functionality

detect.expected: All packages required by the selected Skill group import successfully

source.recommendedLockedVersion: the exact versions and direct wheel hashes in runtime/wheelhouse-manifest.json

windows.license: per-package licenses in the wheel metadata

authenticode.policy: Wheels are not EXE installers; verify every wheel SHA-256 and PyPI provenance before placing them on the USB.

sha256.source: PyPI JSON file digests plus installer-side Get-FileHash

environment.CODEX_PYTHON: absolute path recorded by runtime installer

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Install into a new versioned per-user environment and switch the Codex runtime pointer only after health checks; keep the old environment for rollback.

artifacts.purpose: Optional Node.js runtime for the official Feishu/Lark MCP package

detect.expected: Node.js 20.x or newer with npm available

authenticode.policy: Valid Authenticode chain for the trusted Node.js/OpenJS release; record the signer subject in the installer lock.

sha256.source: Node.js release SHASUMS and installer-side Get-FileHash

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Manage through Windows installed apps; only upgrade together with a tested Feishu MCP package version. This is not a main-chain dependency.
